verdict.rationale: Teller documents a quickstart that ends with linking your first financial accounts, plus a simulated sandbox environment with test credentials such as OTP code 0000. API access uses Teller-issued mTLS client certificates, but the evidence never shows these are self-serve at signup, and the only client library shown is a React hook/component for Teller Connect rather than server SDKs in multiple languages. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve credential issuance at signup, backend client libraries across languages, proof the quickstart is runnable end-to-end and fast, and independent hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-link.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language

citations.quote: finish up by linking your first financial accounts to Teller.
